file.description: XLSX, display headers, ISO text dates, Made SLA present, work notes only. Triggers no known bug — must not change.
Same data as UTF-8 CSV without BOM (F-01 encoding).
Same data as UTF-8 CSV with BOM (F-02 BOM/Number).
XLSX without the Made SLA column (F-03).
XLSX with dd/mm/yyyy text dates in Opened, Closed and work-note headers (F-04).
UTF-8 CSV with dd/mm/yyyy dates (F-04 + F-01).
XLSX whose Work notes column interleaves (Additional comments) entries (F-05).
Realistic worst case: CSV with BOM, snake_case headers, dd/mm dates, no Made SLA, mixed journal.
